text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day,
while training together with Gran 
Alegria—

text_block_list.name: Gran's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um! Gran Alegria-san! Please take 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ? Um~, a letter?

text_block_list.name: Gran's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I-I'm a big fan of yours!
I even went 
to watch your last race... Um,
you were so 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~!! Thank youuu!!
I'm touched at 120 
miles per hour~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'm so happy~! Pure bliss~! —Oh, I 
know!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: May I eat these, the dates?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever something happy happens, I eat 
one date palm!" That's my personal rule!
choice_data_list: If it's the rules, it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yay! Mile-y happy~âª
choice_data_list: Can't be helped if it's the rules.

text_block_list.name: Gran's Fan
text_block_list.text: Ah...! In that case, may I join you?

text_block_list.name: Gran's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I've started eating dates too, just like 
Gran-san!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wah, really~!? I'm so happy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Let's eat, let's eat~! Let's eat 
together~! This makes my happiness shoot 
up 200 miles an hour!!"

text_block_list.name: Gran's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Gran-san! I'll keep 
cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, thank YOU for the letter! I'll keep 
giving it my all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ Miles♪ Miles♪ Happy happy miles~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My Rules are expanding♪ Surprise! Happy! 
1,000 Miles~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the wonderful interaction
between 
Gran Alegria and her fans,
I couldn't help 
but—
choice_data_list: Could I have a piece, too?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ? Could it be that you're hungry?
choice_data_list: Could I have one piece, too?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I get it now—!! Well then, I'm gonna eat 
one more piece too~!
choice_data_list: No. I want to try making my own pe...
No. I want to try making my own pe...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mile♪ Mile♪ Happy mile~♪ Together with 
Gran♪ Happy mile~♪
